selected_architecture: Separate legal-truth and customer-risk axes. A single legal_customer_projection resolver consumes the validated Impressum sidecar and drives consolidated finding creation, Strategic Relevance eligibility, mandatory top-four ordering, cover warning, roadmap/closing persistence and final omission validation.
smallest_robust_slice: No new external capability. Add one resolver, one end-to-end projection validator, one optional finding.customer_risk schema field, bounded customer copy, and regression coverage. Keep the 48-metric score core unchanged.

options_considered.reason: would change score semantics, coverage comparability and the existing legal score firewall

options_considered.option: Set every possible legal issue to severity=critical
options_considered.reason: would conflate customer urgency with legal certainty and indirectly alter blocker_present semantics

options_considered.option: Separate customer-risk priority from legal claim state
options_considered.reason: preserves strict legal assertions while preventing omission of material business risk

strongest_counterargument: Higher warning sensitivity can alarm customers when jurisdiction is unresolved. The mitigation is to keep the claim state POSSIBLE_LEGAL_REVIEW and use explicit review wording while still making the observed operator-opacity risk visible.
failure_mode_chain: sidecar detects provider opacity -> severity/metric-link routing loses signal -> legal finding is not eligible or is displaced -> customer PDF appears green -> customer infers no material issue. Controls: customer_risk priority, legal evidence route, rank-1 mandatory selection, cover warning and legal_risk_projection_completeness hard gate.
security_boundary: No new network, browser, API or private-data capability. Existing public read-only audit and legal-source boundaries remain unchanged.
runtime_assumptions: Exact production font availability remains external to this patch; proof builds may use the existing approved fallback policy.
